grammar.title: Handing something over with 交给
grammar.explanation: 交给 (jiāogěi) means "to hand over to, to give to" the person receiving it usually comes right after 交给, while the thing being handed over is often the topic mentioned first.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiāo gěi nǐ le.
sentences.en: This book has been handed over to you.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiāo gěi wǒ ba.

sentences.en: The money has been given to you.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò jiāo gěi tā zuò.
sentences.en: This work is handed over to him to do.
